dispatch_consult_call_site: harness fleet budget-check (packages/cli/src/commands/fleet/budget-check.ts) — referenced by the fleet-family.md DISPATCH contract and fleet-command SKILL.md DISPATCH step 8
config_key: agent.budget shape reused via --envelope / --period / --fleet / --fleet-envelope flags (SpendEnvelope: envelopeTokens + perFleet)
assumptions: The fleet path denominates its envelope in burn UNITS (burn's portable, price-weighted spend metric), because that is the unit burn attributes per-fleet; the core primitive is unit-agnostic and the orchestrator continues to use raw tokens. Stated at each call site rather than silently mixed.

The fleet key for per-fleet attribution on the fleet path is the invoking SKILL name (burn's `skills` block, tried bare and as `harness:<name>`), not the orchestrator's `fleet:` issue label — the two paths attribute by different natural keys.
budget-check reads observed spend from burn's existing summary (#1270) and refreshes it by default; a failed rescan falls through to the cached summary rather than faking a green.
Exit code 10 encodes EXHAUSTED (distinct from generic 1/2 errors) so a fleet skill/agent can branch; within/unconfigured exit 0.
